versions.title: Version 1 · before five-project QA
versions.purpose: Review the original construction workbench before validation, interaction, programme-label and IFC QA improvements.
versions.status: Frozen historical model and calculations; shared navigation and responsive presentation. Use v3 for the current detailed review.

versions.title: Version 2 · five-project QA improvements
versions.purpose: Use the maintained linked 2D, 3D, quantity and Gantt workbench, with stronger validation, inspection controls and exchange checks.
versions.status: Preserved v2 workbench baseline; the existing root address and v2 still derive from one source.

versions.title: Version 3 · detailed drawings and quantities
versions.purpose: Inspect excavation cut-edge clearances, named members, source-linked reinforcement and individual bars, configurable annotation layers and concrete material scenarios.
versions.status: Current detailed source review; not issued for construction or bar fabrication.

policy: V1 is a checksum-verified frozen model/calculation snapshot with a shared navigation and mobile reading shell. V2 and the existing URL are generated from the same maintained workbench source. The hub and change report derive from this version record and shared comparison text. Historical snapshots are not duplicate editable masters. V3 derives from the same base model and v2 work calculators with a separate, source-linked review patch record; v2 geometry and quantities are preserved.
